historicalBaselines.warning: Indiana historical baseline rows are official county-level presidential results from Indiana Election Division ENR archives for 2016 and 2020. Use them as contextual baseline rows, not as 2024 certified data. The official 2012 archive page is source-cited in the coverage inventory, but the checked ENR JSON paths did not expose a script-readable county presidential category artifact, so 2012 remains a request/follow-up gap.
